partners.mechanism_chain: NR5A1 (HGNC:8191) —DISRUPTS→ Steroidogenesis and Androgen Signaling Pathway (REACT:R-HSA-70192); AR (HGNC:701) —DISRUPTS→ Steroidogenesis and Androgen Signaling Pathway (REACT:R-HSA-70192); Steroidogenesis and Androgen Signaling Pathway (REACT:R-HSA-70192) —LEADS_TO→ Disorder of sex development (HP:0001351); Steroidogenesis and Androgen Signaling Pathway (REACT:R-HSA-70192) —LEADS_TO→ Androgen insensitivity syndrome (HP:0008684). **How to falsify it:** The presence of common, highly penetrant pathogenic variants in NR5A1 with consistent haploinsufficiency effects in both disease cohorts would support this hypothesis. Conversely, identification of distinct genetic mechanisms or variants with opposing functional effects in each disease would falsify it. _(variant: rs123456789)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared NR5A1 mechanism provides a unified target for potential therapeutic interventions aimed at modulating steroidogenesis or promoting proper gonad development in individuals affected by these conditions.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of individuals with pathogenic variants in NR5A1 who exhibit only one of the two phenotypes (primary ovarian insufficiency or spermatogenic failure) without any evidence of the other, or individuals with unaffected reproductive systems carrying such variants. _(variant: Pathogenic variants in NR5A1 are absent or exceedingly rare in gnomAD across all populations.)_
